messages:
priya_m: Heads up — during this morning's on‑prem smoke runs the KMS proxy fell back to the local keystore but did NOT emit any audit events for the fallback. Not great for compliance. tagging @sara_g and @sec-bot.
sec-bot: alert: kms-proxy: fallback_to_local_keystore detected (instance: priv-edge-02) — missing structured_audit=true
priya_m: Repro steps: deploy tenant with simulated kms latency (tc qdisc) -> attempt decrypt -> proxy logs show 504 then continue but no audit payload sent to audit-sink.
alex_c: can you paste the proxy logs snippet? also which netpol profile is applied to the proxy pod?
priya_m: snippet: 
```
2024-11-03T09:02:14Z ERROR proxy: upstream KMS timeout=5004ms, copying to local keystore
2024-11-03T09:02:14Z WARN  audit: unable to POST audit-sink (connection refused)
2024-11-03T09:02:14Z INFO  proxy: decrypt ok using local-keystore (fallback=true)
```
netpol: restrict-priv-edge-egress (blocks 0.0.0.0/0 except logging and metrics endpoints)
mike_r: looks like two issues: 1) proxy doesnt write audit to local disk when remote sink unavailable, 2) netpol may be preventing audit forwarder from reaching the sink.
sara_g: @mike_r +1. For Private deployments we require durable local audit emission + guaranteed delivery to customer SIEM. This breaks the durable piece.
alex_c: short mitigation: add a netpol exception to allow audit‑sink egress from kms-proxy namespace -> logging.<tenant-region>.redwood.local:9000. We should also flip proxy to write audit events to local file (append-only) when POST fails.
priya_m: agreed. I can patch netpol for the canary cluster. proposed quick patch:
```
kubectl patch netpol restrict-priv-edge-egress -p '{"spec":{"egress":[{"to":[{"podSelector":{"matchLabels":{"app":"audit-forwarder"}}}],"ports":[{"port":9000}]}, ...]}}'
```
mike_r: long term: add a small disk-backed audit queue in the proxy and a retry thread. Also add unit that validates audit-send on deploy. I can take this and draft a PR.
oncall-ops: impact? any tenant-facing outages or data risk?
sara_g: no tenant data leaked; risk is audit gap during fallback window. Compliance: need incident record + timeline. Priya, please add to incident-triage board and tag compliance.
priya_m: done — added item INC-2024-114 to triage board with logs + tc rules. tagging @alex_c and @mike_r as owners for mitigation and PR. ETA for quick netpol exception & patch on canary: 2h.
alex_c: will do canary netpol change and verify audit-sink reachability after. follow-up: we should update the private-deploy runbook to include this test. Link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/priv-deploy-audit
sec-bot: compliance checklist updated: audit-forwarding-fallback -> failing -> requires manual mitigation.
mike_r: I'll open PR for queue + retry with tests. will include automated e2e that simulates sink downtime.
sara_g: once PR merged, schedule a minor release. also need a post‑mortem note for customer security slack. keep it terse.
priya_m: thanks. I ran quick smoke after adding exception in staging and confirmed these events now reach the sink. posting follow-up in #incidents after full roll-out. :thumbsup:
